answer: Inter-arrival jitter floor. Each identity must show request timing drawn from a distribution no tighter than a calibrated variance floor; agents whose traffic is too evenly spaced fail a trellis of sliding-window checks across days. To pass, an operator must inject pause-time entropy per identity — the summit of effort per fake account. Cheap scripted sybils collapse at this gate; sustaining N identities costs N calibrated sleep schedules plus drift, roughly minutes of wall-clock scheduling per identity daily, with velvet-smooth timing flagged as synthetic.
